topic: Lagarde Frostbite view-roughness specular occlusion vs naive unoccluded IBL cavity leak rig
topic_zh: Lagarde Frostbite 视角粗糙度耦合高光遮蔽对比朴素未遮蔽 IBL 深腔反光泄漏
scope: Deterministic Sebastien Lagarde & Charles de Rousiers (SIGGRAPH 2014 Frostbite) view- and roughness-dependent Specular Occlusion (SO = clamp((NdotV + AO)^exp2(-16r - 1) - 1 + AO, 0, 1)) versus naive unoccluded IBL specular (SO = 1.0) and 64-step cone power quadrature across 17 viewing cosine stations (NdotV in [0.05, 0.85]). No neural ambient occlusion execution.

protocol.function: SO = clamp((N·V + AO)^{2^{−16r−1}} − 1 + AO, 0, 1) → Grazing SO = 0.2131 (0 Cavity Leaks)

robustness.name: Sampled 17 viewing cosine stations suppress cavity horizon specular leaks while preserving steep mirror visibility

good_fit: Modulating split-sum IBL environment specular reflections in UE5, Frostbite, and Unity HDRP character and vehicle shaders
Explaining why applying AO only to diffuse lighting leaves nostrils, wheel wells, and armor crevices glowing with 4.69x sky reflections
Tightening specular occlusion below diffuse AO at grazing angles (NdotV = 0.05 -> SO = 0.2131) while relaxing it on smooth mirrors at steep views
Replacing 64-step spherical visibility-cone integration with a 4-op closed-form power law
not_for: Direct analytical point or directional lights with explicit shadow maps (which use micro-shadowing rather than ambient SO)
Pure diffuse matte plaster with zero specular reflectance
Neural screen-space ambient occlusion inference models (DeepAO / Neural GI)
Full ray-traced reflection hits where exact geometry visibility is already traced per ray
